about: The allowed exceptions of the size ratchet (scripts/audit/size-limits.mjs, test packages/core/test/size-limits.test.ts): the files, functions, parameter lists and nesting of packages/*/src over the limits, each entry with its size today, each group with one measure and a one-line reason. A new entry, a size above or below its recorded one, an entry back within its limit and a function over a limit without a key of its own all fail: split the code (or name the function), or after a change run node scripts/audit/size-limits.mjs --write-baseline, write the reason of any new group and review the diff. The baseline only shrinks.

groups.reason: Runs in the page (serialised with toString(), handed to page.evaluate, or the page kit's installer): one self-contained function, its parts named inner helpers, since a module helper does not reach the page.

CDP event handlers that share one attach's mutable state (the main frame id, the heal timer and its refreshes, the frames seen): a split would thread a state object through every handler and read worse.
Public API, exported from a package entry (or the mirror of one): the signature stays.
Commander's action callbacks: the signature is commander's.
Per-frame pixel and rectangle code: positional coordinates read best, and no object is built per call.
Runs in the page through page.evaluate: one self-contained function (a module helper does not reach the page), its collect and restore walks nested inside it.
